name: App Store
description: Browse, install and update agentproto apps. Projects the daemon's catalog and installed app registry into one storefront (featured shelf, category filters, detail pages, install drawer, update badges) and dispatches the existing app_catalog / app_list / app_updates / app_install / app_resync / app_uninstall / app_ui_app verbs and its own app_store.scaffold tool. Installs keep the existing preview-then-confirm step (source URL, pinned digest or commit, and whether a build command runs) before any write.
tagline: Browse, install and update agentproto apps, no CLI needed.
longDescription:
A storefront for your agentproto daemon. Browse the public catalog, install an
app in two steps and keep every app up to date, without touching the CLI.

## Discover

A featured shelf and a filterable grid over the public catalog, with the
tagline, icon, screenshots and version of each app. Open a card for the full
description, requirements, publisher and license.

## Install with a preview

Install never writes before you confirm. The drawer first shows the source, the
pinned digest or commit and whether a build command would run. Confirm to
install; cancel and nothing changed. Prefer the terminal? Each detail page also
carries the exact CLI install line.

## Stay current

The Installed view lists what runs on your daemon and badges every app that is
behind its catalog release. Update shows the version change first, then resyncs
from the same catalog the app came from.

## Manage

Open an app's UI in its own tab, or uninstall it with an inline confirmation.
Built-in panels are listed too, but are never removable.

## Requirements

App Store talks to your local agentproto daemon. It sits beside the built-in
store panel, which stays available as a fallback.
